name: Custom Static Analysis Rule Development
description: Development of custom static analysis rules and queries for detecting organization-specific or novel vulnerability patterns. Covers Semgrep rule authoring, CodeQL query development, custom checker creation, and rule testing and validation.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to custom static analysis rule development

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands that SAST tools support custom rules and their purpose
evidence: Can explain the value of custom rules for detecting organization-specific patterns
Familiar with Semgrep rule syntax or CodeQL query concepts
Understands pattern matching and data flow analysis in SAST engines

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Writes basic custom rules under supervision
evidence: Authored simple Semgrep rules or CodeQL queries for known patterns
Tested rules against known-vulnerable code samples
Rules reviewed and validated by authorized analyst
Completed hands-on training on at least one rule authoring framework

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently writes and validates custom rules for engagement-specific patterns
evidence: Independently authored custom rules deployed on 3+ engagements
Writes data flow rules that track taint from sources to sinks
Tests rules against true positive and false positive test cases
Passed proficiency assessment on custom rule development

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Develops complex rules; maintains rule libraries; optimizes performance
evidence: Maintains a library of reusable custom rules for the lab
Develops inter-procedural and cross-file analysis rules
Optimizes rule performance for large codebases
Mentors others on rule authoring best practices

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Authority on custom SAST rule development; contributes to the community
evidence: Published custom rules or research on static analysis techniques
Developed the lab's custom rule development standards and testing framework
Contributes rules to open-source SAST rule repositories
Trains teams on advanced rule development techniques

assessment_methods.description: Given a novel vulnerability pattern, write a custom Semgrep or CodeQL rule that detects it with acceptable precision
Review of custom rules authored for quality, test coverage, and detection effectiveness
